newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES WEAKER ON HARD UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES WEAKER ON HARD UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted easier against key currencies at the close of Wednesday's interbank session.
"There wasn't much happening today -- just a few movements here and there on the back of import payments and a few inflows," a dealer commented.
He said the local currency ended the day at 11.3275/3375 against the U.S. dollar, down from Tuesday's 11.3175/3275.

It also weakened against the crosses; finishing at 18.4870/5090 from 18.4300/4500 versus sterling, at 2.5460/5660 against the rand from 2.5400/5600 and at 6.5760/5840 from 6.5400/5600 against the mark.
